sourceReview.reason: Unable to verify the claimed $1.96 billion cumulative tokenized-stock trading volume or a new November 10 event from a dated primary dataset. Accessible reports describe different measures and periods (October $1.9B/90 days and $2B cumulative, November $2.7B weekly across venues); the original Cryptonews.net Google News redirect is not a verified full-text source. Hold pending primary data and measurement-period reconciliation.
